$comment: Example tasks published on the Store by scripts/publish-tasks.mjs after every deploy (CI only). Each one is a search people type, with its own Google-indexed landing page and .md (manager/rules/SEO.md section 18). Limits: title 63, description 400, seoTitle 60, seoDescription 160 (154 kept), 10 per actor. inputSchemaFields must stay fields of the input schema, or the page stops showing after a build. options.memoryMbytes is the default memory measured on Apify for store.json defaultRunOptions: 2048 MB, about 1 minute for a search of every job site (runs yBoCIZDTtcAkjBI1E and FxhK3ledZa4kIpTMl, build 1.0.1, 2026-11-03).

tasks.name: lever-jobs-last-24-hours
tasks.title: Find the newest Lever jobs posted in the last 24 hours
tasks.description: Get the 100 newest jobs that companies created on Lever in the last day, with the company, location, pay when shown, and link. Set Number of jobs to 0 to get every one, and schedule it daily for a fresh feed of new jobs.
tasks.seoTitle: New Lever Jobs in the Last 24 Hours
tasks.seoDescription: The newest jobs created on Lever job sites in the last day, with company, location, pay and link. Run it daily for a fresh feed of new jobs.

tasks.name: remote-jobs-on-lever
tasks.title: Find remote jobs on Lever job sites
tasks.description: Get the newest remote jobs from 2,300+ companies on Lever, with the company, location, pay when shown, posting date and link. Remote is the workplace type the company set on Lever.
tasks.seoTitle: Remote Jobs on Lever Job Sites
tasks.seoDescription: Search 2,300+ companies on Lever for remote jobs at once, newest first, with company, pay, posting date and link. No login needed.

tasks.name: software-engineer-jobs-lever
tasks.title: Find software engineer jobs on Lever job sites
tasks.description: Search 2,300+ companies on Lever for software engineer jobs at once and get the 100 newest, with the company, location, pay when shown, posting date and link.
tasks.seoTitle: Software Engineer Jobs on Lever Job Sites
tasks.seoDescription: The newest software engineer jobs on Lever job sites, with company, location, pay and link. One search across 2,300+ companies.

tasks.name: sales-jobs-europe-lever
tasks.title: Find sales jobs in Europe on Lever job sites
tasks.description: Get the newest sales and account executive jobs in Europe from 2,300+ companies on Lever, with the company, location, pay when shown and link. Europe finds jobs in its 51 countries, jobs posted for the region and jobs open worldwide.
tasks.seoTitle: Sales Jobs in Europe on Lever Job Sites
tasks.seoDescription: Sales and account executive jobs in Europe from 2,300+ companies on Lever, newest first, with company, pay and link. No login or API key.

tasks.name: lever-jobs-with-descriptions
tasks.title: Get Lever jobs with full descriptions and country
tasks.description: Get the newest jobs on Lever with full details: the description as text and HTML, the country and country code, and pay as numbers with its currency and period where the company publishes it (a third of jobs). Ready for a job board or an AI agent.
tasks.seoTitle: Lever Jobs With Full Descriptions and Country
tasks.seoDescription: Newest Lever jobs with the full description as text and HTML, the country, and pay as numbers with its period where published. Clean JSON.

tasks.name: palantir-jobs-lever
tasks.title: Get every open Palantir job
tasks.description: Get every open job at Palantir from its Lever job site, live, with the location, work type, team, posting date and link.
tasks.seoTitle: Palantir Jobs API: Every Open Role on Lever
tasks.seoDescription: Every open Palantir job, read live from its Lever job site, with location, work type, team, posting date and link. No login or API key.

tasks.name: internships-on-lever
tasks.title: Find internships on Lever job sites
tasks.description: Get the newest internships from 2,300+ companies on Lever, read from each company's own job type words, with the company, location, pay when shown, posting date and link.
tasks.seoDescription: The newest internships from 2,300+ companies hiring on Lever, with company, location, pay when shown and link. Search them all in one run.

tasks.name: check-lever-job-links
tasks.title: Check whether Lever job links are still open
tasks.description: Paste Lever job links and each comes back open, closed or not found, with the job's details when it is open. Handy for cleaning dead links out of a job board or a spreadsheet.
tasks.seoTitle: Check if Lever Job Links Are Still Open
tasks.seoDescription: Paste Lever job links and see which are open, closed or gone. Clean dead links out of a job board or a spreadsheet, with no login or API key.
